The tabbed code-sample widget only carries over as a filename label with no actual code text, so the code snippets themselves are lost even though the surrounding documentation reads fine. Verified 2026-08-17.

thedailybeast.note: Full article body, inline images with captions, an embedded video thumbnail card, and a legal-document screenshot are all captured in both clip and cast, but the main headline ('Peter Thiel's Bombshell...') is missing -- content starts directly at body prose. Verified 2026-08-17.

theintercept.note: Source has an email-gate overlay mid-article but the full underlying text was present in the DOM and captured completely, including the faded paragraph. Title, byline, hero photo with caption, and full body all present in clip and cast; a 'Latest Stories' recirculation block at the very end is a trivial, non-disruptive addition. Verified 2026-08-17.

tiktok-foryou.note: Clip captures the video poster frame, title, caption/hashtags, and stat icons (heart/comment/bookmark/share) with counts intact and legible -- about as good as a video feed capture can be. The cast strips the icons down to bare numbers ('6659 . 94 . 886 . 284') with no icon or label context, so the meaning of each figure is lost; it also shows a different video frame than the clip's poster. Verified 2026-08-17.

tiktok-profile.note: Source page itself shows TikTok's own 'Something went wrong / Please try again later' error in place of the video grid (real site behavior when logged out, not a capture defect); clip faithfully reproduces the profile header plus that error state. The cast additionally pulls in a large off-screen 'Suggested accounts' celebrity-follow list (dozens of names/follower counts) that never appeared in the clip -- notable chrome leak unique to the cast. Verified 2026-08-17.

wikidata.note: Statement values (human, images, signature, male, United Kingdom, dates, etc.) are all present in both clip and cast, but the bold left-column property labels (instance of, sex or gender, country of citizenship, date of birth, etc.) that give each value meaning are entirely missing -- the two-column property:value layout collapsed to a flat unlabeled list of values. Verified 2026-08-17.

wiktionary.note: Every dictionary section (Etymology, Pronunciation, Noun senses, Synonyms, Derived terms, Translations, See also, Verb, Further reading, Anagrams, Categories) captured completely and legibly in both clip and cast. Verified 2026-08-17.
